title: AgentMeasure Outcome Unit (v1, rev 0.2: + action / usage_aggregate)
description: BP r28 p14 'Emerging · Outcome' row: the billable unit for outcome-priced contracts beyond per-resolution support — a qualified lead, a completed case. This schema defines the unit BEFORE any engine reads it: one file, one unit, every field traceable to a contract clause or an observer. Judgement discipline mirrors AMS-1: a criterion that cannot be evidenced is listed in criteria_unproven, never silently counted; status 'unproven' is a first-class state. vendor and buyer each keep their own units; agreement is a separate reconciliation, never assumed.

unit_id.description: Stable id of this billable outcome in the declaring party's system.

unit_type.description: qualified_lead: sales outcome pricing. completed_case: BPO / services outcome pricing. action: per-action billing (Copilot premium request, Cursor credit, Devin ACU) — v0.2, one unit = one consumed action, allowance via billing_context. usage_aggregate: metered usage (A3, e.g. compute units) — v0.2, quantity via measured_quantity. Per-resolution support stays on the canonical seven-column export (registry/vendor-rules.json). One evidence plane, four unit types.

contract_ref.description: The contract clause that defines qualification / completion, cited by section. A unit without a clause is not a unit.

occurred_at.description: When the outcome happened (lead qualified, case completed). ISO 8601.

declared_by.description: Which side counts this unit. Both sides' ledgers reconcile; neither is authoritative by itself.

observer_grade.description: Same evidence ladder as AMS-1 settlement (standard/SETTLEMENT.md): who observed the outcome.

criteria_met.description: Each contract criterion this unit satisfies, in the contract's own words.

criteria_unproven.description: Criteria that cannot be evidenced from the supplied records. Listed, never guessed away.

status.description: counted: both the criteria and the evidence stand. disputed: a party contests it. retracted: declarer withdrew. unproven: criteria_unproven is non-empty, so it must not enter any claim total.

stability_hours.description: Contractual observation window after which the outcome is stable (e.g. lead not withdrawn within N hours).

reopened_at.description: Timestamps of any reopen/withdrawal events inside the window.

value.description: Contracted value of one unit, when priced.

billing_context.description: For action units: where this consumption sits relative to the plan allowance. An action inside the allowance and an overage action are different money; they are never merged.

measured_quantity.description: For usage_aggregate units: the measured quantity as recorded, with its unit. The metering is the vendor's telemetry, taken as input — AgentMeasure verifies billing, not telemetry.
